My dear [Mrs Mercier](/person/990),
Your recollections of [Mr Peabody](/person/990) are very touching, and I hope they will appear in February - January is pretty well done for! I am sorry for the blunder about Christabel, it came of lending the book and trusting to memory[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Mercier\'s novel Christabel Hope, or, The Beginnings of Life (London, Warne 1869) was noticed in ‘Hints on Reading’ MP 8 (December 1869) 619 as Christabel Ross.
